comment: Smogon sample-team thread URLs per format id. Add or correct URLs freely — the scraper visits every listed thread, follows pokepast.es links, reads inline importables in the opening post, and reports per-thread counts and page titles (verify a corrected id against the title in the next last-harvest.json).

tournament.comment: Team-dump threads ({url, format} pins a format for pastes without === headers) and tournament forum listings to walk. Paste === headers and replay-link ids attribute formats directly; thread prefixes fall back through the rmt prefix maps.

rmt.comment: RMT forum listing to walk (rate-my-team.148 is the forum whose rows carry Gen-N labels; rmt-archive.469 is a suggestions forum). Threads are attributed via their prefix label: prefixMap maps tier prefixes directly, genPrefixMap maps generation-only labels with the tier read from the thread title — non-gen7 generations are mapped so they resolve (to untracked formats, quietly skipped) instead of reporting as unmapped every run. Truly unmapped prefixes are reported by the scraper log so the maps can grow.
